notes:
v4.6.7 — Hotfix: silence/remove/unsilence/cloud-callback crashes

🐛 FIXED
• 'RuntimeError: wrapped C/C++ object of type QLabel has been deleted' when clicking Silence / Remove / Unsilence in More Bots. Root cause: MoreBotsTab.refresh() called setVisible() on two placeholder QLabels (_none_lbl / _none_sil) AFTER _rebuild_grid() had deleted them in a previous pass. New _safe_placeholder_visible() helper detects the dead reference and recreates the label in place.
• 'RuntimeError: wrapped C/C++ object of type QPushButton has been deleted' from BotProcessWidget cloud callbacks. Same root cause — an async _on_done fires after the user navigated away and the widget was destroyed. _set_running and _log now bail silently when their child widgets are gone.

Follow-up release. Many user-requested features (per-bot universe bundling, Paper/Live switch in header, custom-bots on web dashboard, per-model credit cost, algorithmic copyright + moderation bots, marketplace upload fix) are queued for v4.6.8+.
